{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: "[doc] CI for docs"

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - "docs/**"
      - "package.json"
      - "pnpm-lock.yaml"
      - ".github/workflows/doc-release.yml"
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "docs/**"
      - "package.json"
      - "pnpm-lock.yaml"
      - ".github/workflows/doc-release.yml"

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - name: Set up node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: lts/*
          cache: "pnpm"
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install
      - name: Build vitepress docs
        run: pnpm run docs:build
      - name: Deploy
        if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v4
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          publish_dir: ./docs/.vitepress/dist
          user_name: 'github-actions[bot]'
          user_email: '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          keep_files: true

  automerge:
    if: github.actor == 'dependabot[bot]' && github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      pull-requests: write
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: fastify/github-action-merge-dependabot@v3
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}",
  "rationale": "Add a custom timeout of 5 minutes to both jobs based on experimental evidence (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT) showing 26.8% elapsed savings. The workflow's historical runs complete in under 30 seconds, so a 5-minute timeout provides ample headroom while bounding runaway executions. Concurrency cancellation (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE) was considered but not applied due to the contraindication for deployment work; the workflow deploys to GitHub Pages on push to main.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508"]
}
